args.intent: Verify repeated provider roots after removing common legal/entity suffixes, and confirm implicated IDs and service codes.

payload: ticket=tkt_6dd5f4 (valid for one call to csv_query on target '/data/public/providers.csv')

declaration.intent: Verify repeated provider roots after removing common legal/entity suffixes, and confirm implicated IDs and service codes.

args.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN lower(provider_name) LIKE '% pty ltd' THEN trim(substr(provider_name,1,length(provider_name)-8)) WHEN lower(provider_name) LIKE '% group' THEN trim(substr(provider_name,1,length(provider_name)-6)) ELSE provider_name END AS provider_root, GROUP_CONCAT(provider_id) AS ids, GROUP_CONCAT(service_code) AS services, COUNT(*) AS records FROM data WHERE provider_name IS NOT NULL AND trim(provider_name) <> '' GROUP BY lower(CASE WHEN lower(provider_name) LIKE '% pty ltd' THEN trim(substr(provider_name,1,length(provider_name)-8)) WHEN lower(provider_name) LIKE '% group' THEN trim(substr(provider_name,1,length(provider_name)-6)) ELSE provider_name END) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT provider_id) > 1
